# Anoop Sinkaran
Blacktown NSW, Australia • 0406 295 160 • ns.anoop@gmail.com • linkedin.com/in/anoop-sinkaran

Hiring Team  
Rabobank Australia  
Sydney NSW, Australia  

**Re: Senior Quality Engineer - Mobile**

Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Quality Engineer - Mobile position within Rabobank Australia’s Mobile Banking Squad. With over 19 years of software testing and quality engineering experience across native mobile applications, APIs, and payments infrastructure, I am eager to contribute to delivering secure, reliable, and high-performing mobile banking experiences for your customers across Australia and New Zealand.

Throughout my career, most recently as a Senior Quality Engineer at Wpay (Woolworths Group), I have defined quality architectures and built automation frameworks for native iOS and Android applications using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android Espresso, iOS XCUITest, and Playwright. My experience aligns directly with Rabobank’s focus on integrating quality controls into CI/CD pipelines, having engineered Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions workflows for API Gateway regression suites and mobile security analysis (MobSF). Additionally, during my tenure as QA Lead at Avant Mutual and Senior Quality Engineer at Wpay, I routinely led risk-based testing, cross-functional release management, and daily defect triage sessions to enforce strict quality gates prior to production rollouts.

As a Google Cloud Generative AI certified engineer, I actively apply modern AI engineering tools to elevate quality assurance processes. At Wpay, I designed custom GitHub Copilot SKILLs and automated PR review workflows to streamline script generation and catch test coverage gaps early. Combined with my background across card payment processing, digital wallets, and system integrations, I bring both technical depth and domain insight to coach engineers, manage test environments, and drive continuous improvement within Agile delivery teams.

I am based in Sydney and welcome the opportunity to join Rabobank's hybrid team. Thank you for your time and consideration, and I look forward to discussing how my mobile automation, AI tool integration, and quality leadership experience can support the Mobile Banking Squad.

Sincerely,  

**Anoop Sinkaran**
